say: In this town, everybody has a girlfriend. Except me.
You see, everywhere you look, there's a couple.
Couples at the park. Couples at the pizza place.
Even the two snowmen in my neighbor's yard are holding hands.
My best friend Tyler has a girlfriend.
My little brother has a girlfriend.
Even my grandpa has a girlfriend, and he's ninety two.
So I tried everything. I wrote a love letter. The wind blew it into a lake.
I bought roses. A dog ate them.
Then came the biggest night of the year. The Valentine's dance.
Everybody walked in holding hands. I walked in holding a juice box.
Then the music stopped, and the door opened. A new girl walked in. Alone.
She looked around the whole room, and walked straight up to me.
She said, are you the only one here without a girlfriend?
I said, yeah. She said, cool. I'm the only one without a boyfriend.
Now, in this town, everybody has a girlfriend. Including me.
